About.title: About me
About.lead: I'm a fullstack developer passionate about building useful, well-crafted software.
paragraphs: My main focus is the backend: REST APIs with Node, Nest.js and Express, PHP with Laravel, and Python with FastAPI, Flask and Django. I model data on MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle and MongoDB, and containerize with Docker so a project runs the same on any machine.
On the client side I work with React, Next.js, Vue.js and Angular on TypeScript and Tailwind, caring about accessibility and performance from the first commit.

Lately I build systems that integrate language models without giving up auditability: data extraction with confidence measured field by field, semantic search with verifiable citations, and security test suites aligned with OWASP. I care about AI reaching production backed by evidence, not promises.
I'm motivated by collaborating with teams, writing code others can read effortlessly, and shipping products that solve real problems.
